title: Daily Chess Puzzle
description: Enjoy over 700 daily chess puzzles in a sunny, beach-themed world. Lighthearted, relaxing, and perfect for summer fun anytime.

title: Ninja Time
description: Immerse yourself in the world of samurai and ninjas in Ninja Time. Stretch your bamboo stick to navigate increasingly complex levels, collecting coins for new ninja skins. Experience Japan's martial arts era and become the ultimate ninja legend!

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2025
description:
In "Car Mechanic Simulator 2025", you are a master restorer who breathes new life into forgotten cars! 

Your task is to find old, broken, and abandoned cars, disassemble them down to the last screw, repair them, replace parts, and reassemble them, turning rusty piles of metal into shiny legends of the automotive industry. Search for rare spare parts, restore engines, choose the perfect paint, and bring every detail to perfection.

title: Brainrot Merge
description:
Merge adorably weird Italian brainrot characters! 
Combine them to unlock rare (and even weirder) species. 
Build the ultimate brainrot paradise!

title: Survival in Area 51
description: You will play as the character Stas, who works in Area 51. One day, Stas was given a strange task, to find acid and pour it into an unusual device. Then something terrible happened... In Area 51, an explosion occurred underground, and zombies appeared. They began to attack scientists and guards. Your task is to destroy zombies, mercenaries and find a way out of this terrible underground place. The game offers shooting, simple puzzles, a plot, many locations and a final battle.

title: Fix Da Brainrot
description: Fix Da Brainrot is a quirky jigsaw puzzle game with pieces that look like torn paper. Pick your challenge —16 pieces for a quick and easy fix or 32 pieces for a real brain teaser. Drag, drop, and fit the torn pieces together, and watch the picture slowly come alive as you fix the brainrot and conquer the puzzle!

title: Labuba Halloween Infestation
description: Monsters are invading Halloween! You must destroy them all — the fate of Halloween is in your hands. The game features three different modes, each with tougher and more powerful monsters.

title: Spider Bubu
description: Spider-Bubu swings from wall to wall across the city. Halloween has arrived, and you need to collect all the Halloween candies along with Spider-Bubu. Don’t forget to grab the giant pumpkin too! You must be very careful in the city — sharp spinning blades and pointed spikes are everywhere. Collect all the pumpkins and safely reach the portal that appears in the city.

title: Panda Mahjong Classic
description: The panda has a challenge for you. You will face five tests on your way to the top. Attempt to finish all stages and earn the honor of being a Mahjong master.

title: 3Dash
description: 3Dash is a fast-paced 3D rhythm platformer inspired by Geometry Dash—dash, jump, and flip through dizzying, rotating tracks while keeping perfect time. Tackle six hand-crafted levels, then build your own with the level editor for endless replay

title: Just Mahjong
description:
Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tranquility with "Just Mahjong" — the perfect implementation of classic mahjong solitaire. Enjoy pure gameplay without unnecessary complications, where all attention is paid to the very essence of this famous game.

"Just Mahjong" offers:

Classic Rules: Authentic and time-tested mahjong solitaire gameplay.

Endless Enjoyment: Hundreds of carefully designed layouts guarantee long hours of play.

title: Labubu Pop
description:
Labubu Pop is a bright and cheerful puzzle game where the playful Labubus have completely taken over the box! Connect matching characters into chains, clear the board, and earn points to level up. Each stage brings fun surprises, and even more exciting combos!

With its colorful visuals, smooth animations, and simple yet addictive gameplay, Labubu Pop is perfect for relaxing and having fun anytime. The longer your chain — the higher your score and the flashier the effects!

title: Path ice
description:
Chill the soda, add some ice, but here's the problem, it's not so easy to get into the glass, you need to draw a path for the ice.

Draw the path as you like.
Go through many levels
Discover all kinds of ice and glasses

title: Bubble Trouble
description:
Avoid and pop the bubbles! Shoot the bubbles with your harpoon and split them in smaller bubbles, until eventually they disappear.
The classic arcade game from 2002, remastered.
Bubble Trouble (later Bubble Struggle) has been played hundreds of millions of times, labeled 'one of the top 10 online games'.

22 unique levels, for 1 or 2 players (on the same keyboard).
Final boss level.
Challenge other player's scores.

title: Island Puzzle: Build & Solve
description: Welcome to the ultimate Island Puzzle adventure! Test your logic and strategy skills in this captivating logic puzzle and building game.

title: Halloween Fruit Slice
description: Halloween Fruit Slice is a high-energy arcade action game set in a spooky Halloween world. Vivid fruits and devious traps streak across the screen in an instant. Your task is to slice as many fruits as possible with lightning speed, chaining spectacular combos and racking up points while dodging explosive bombs. Rich visuals, splashy juice effects, and eerie backdrops create a thrilling, immersive atmosphere. The tempo keeps rising, so every moment tests your reflexes and precision.

title: Magic and Wizards Mahjong
description: Enter the enchanting world of Magic & Wizards Mahjong! Match mystical tiles adorned with runes, potions, and magical artifacts across beautifully crafted layouts. Enjoy smooth gameplay with boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. Race against the clock to earn time bonuses, or use extra seconds to finish your quest. With 50 rotating layouts and stunning wizardly visuals, every match feels like a spellbinding adventure for Mahjong lovers and casual players alike.

title: Destruction Simulator
description: Experience the ultimate destruction sandbox! Bend time, shift gravity, and unleash realistic debris effects. Choose from 13+ explosives, quakes, and tornadoes, or craft custom weapons. Wreck 30+ maps or design your own with the advanced map editor!

title: Prásino
description: Prasino is a free-to-play forest adventure game that combines exploration, survival, and environmental restoration. As nature’s last hope, your mission is to travel through beautiful landscapes, collect magical seeds, and revive the forest by planting trees. Along the way, you must watch out for dangerous enemies and manage your breath carefully to keep exploring deeper into the wild.

title: Blankets
description:
Put together cozy blanket pieces with the same colors and patterns to make them disappear and keep your board nice and neat!
With soft colors and a calm, happy feel, Blankets is great for kids who like fun puzzles without too much stress.

Can you build the coziest blanket and get the best score in Blankets?

title: Maze Craze
description: Step into the captivating world of Maze Craze, a puzzle game that combines creativity, humor, and strategic problem-solving. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers, Maze Craze offers an endless journey through a variety of mazes, each with its own unique set of challenges and surprises.

title: Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker
description: Get ready for the cutest twist on the viral Brainrot universe! Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker is the baby-themed sequel to the hit Brainrot Clicker! Tap your way through the baby versions of your favorite characters, collect upgrades, and enjoy a whole new atmosphere with colorful visuals, cheerful music, and fresh sound effects designed to fit the playful baby theme!

title: Fluffy Mania
description: Step into the charming world of Fluffy Mania, where bright, fluffy creatures are ready to test your puzzle-solving skills. This online game combines adorable visuals with clever gameplay, creating a fun and relaxing challenge. Play on desktop or mobile and dive into colorful levels full of lovable characters. Connect matching creatures, score points, and climb through progressively tricky stages.

title: Circuit Master
description: Circuit Master is a puzzle game where you aim to get a green light by connecting the circuit correctly! Arrange the wires, fans, and machines in the right places, then turn on the button to see the electricity flow. Only the correctly connected circuit will make the green light shine. Use hints if you need help.

title: VegaMix Match-3 Village
description: A cozy match-3 with a heartfelt story! ? Visit grandma in the village — she’s a true star with fun tales from her youth. Play classic match-3 levels, earn stars and complete quests for villagers. Bright puzzles, touching stories, colorful graphics and daily bonuses await you. Perfect for short sessions and relaxing breaks. ? For fans of match-3 with plot, coziness and helping heroes.

title: Tag Run
description: Tag Run is an adrenaline-fueled multiplayer action parkour game where 1–4 local players race to ditch the bomb and be the last standing! Tag opponents, use teleport pads and jump springs, and survive thrilling matches with 6 players. Explore six dynamic maps: Pixel, Winter, Lava, Jungle, Candy, and Night, and packed with creative power-ups. Test your reflexes, strategy, and parkour skills in this fast-paced, chaotic playground challenge.

title: Mini Golf Battle
description: Mini Golf Battle is a casual sports puzzle where precision and timing decide the outcome. Your task is to sink the ball into the hole with the fewest strokes possible while navigating ramps, walls, and tricky obstacles. Special power-ups like Fire, Wing, and Spring shots add variety, letting you approach each course with unique strategies. Whether for short play sessions or longer runs, Mini Golf Battle delivers an engaging mix of relaxation and skillful play.

title: My Tiny Market
description: In My Tiny Market, you're the boss of your very own supermarket. Manage your time and resources well to find the perfect balance between all your tasks: restock shelves, serve customers and keep everything running at full speed!

title: Red Hide Ball
description: In Red Hide Ball you protect designated balls from roaming monsters by manipulating the level layout and placing shields or obstacles. Each stage presents a fixed arrangement of elements and predictable monster movements, turning each solution into a small tactical exercise. Success depends on reading patterns, timing actions and using limited moves to create safe zones. The game balances accessible mechanics with steadily increasing difficulty to engage players who enjoy pure logic challenges.

title: Cube to Hole Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Cube to Hole Puzzle!
Get ready for an exciting and brain-teasing experience! In Cube to Hole Puzzle, your objective is simple: fill the colored cubes into their matching colored holes. But there’s a catch—limited space on the board and only a few slots to move the cubes forward. You’ll need to plan ahead and choose the right cube to move first. Strategize carefully to avoid blocking yourself and clear the board to progress through each level!

title: Mall Anomaly
description: Mall Anomaly is not your usual mall trip. Instead of shopping, you’re stuck in endless hallways where mannequins stare, furniture floats, and unusual kitties vanish into thin air. Spot these bizarre anomalies before the place completely glitches out—it’s like spot the difference, but in a cursed shopping center.

title: Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds
description:
Dodge and shoot to survive 15 seconds! Master 40 levels of arrow chaos in this fast-paced pixel art platformer! 

Dive into Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds, a thrilling 2D pixel art platformer where every second counts! As a skilled archer, your mission is to survive 15 seconds per level by dodging deadly hazards and strategically firing arrows.

title: Dinosaur Shifting Run
description: Get ready for a prehistoric race unlike any other! Dinosaur Shifting Run throws you into a thrilling adventure where you transform into mighty dinosaurs to overcome obstacles and outrun rivals.

title: Color Block Jam 2
description: Play Color Block Jam 2 free online in your browser with no download and no install required. This free online puzzle game lets you slide colorful blocks into matching gates through smart logic levels designed to test your brain and timing. Perfect for fans of cool math games, unblocked games, and quick school breaks, it loads fast and works smoothly on desktop and mobile. Enjoy relaxing color block puzzles anytime, anywhere, completely free.

title: Words or Die
description:
Build words to survive — think fast or get crushed!

In this fast-paced word survival game, players race to create words from random letters. Each correct word builds a tower under your feet. Fail to spell on time? Lava rises, and you're out!

 - Stay above the lava
 - Show off your vocabulary skills
 - Compete against others in real-time
 - Choose your character and style
 - Only the smartest will survive!

title: Tricky Challenges: Mini Games
description:
Only 5% will pass all the Challenges! Ready to test your reactions and wit? Take the challenge and prove that you are better than thousands of bloggers!

✨ "Tricky Challenges: Mini Games" is a unique game that combines popular challenges from TipTop and puzzle elements.

title: Frog Knight
description: Frog Bubble your mission is to help a spirited frog pop an array of mischievous bubbles! Using your swift reflexes and strategic skills, you’ll throw your lily pad-shaped projectiles at bubbles to clear each level.

title: Dino Slide
description: A puzle slide game wher you have to feed Dino. Move Dino with the keyboard arrow or swipe. Each level you have to complete the goal that consist in eating fruits and vegetables.

title: Onet Monster Book
description:
A "match-the-pairs" genre game where you need to find matching images and connect them. But it's not that simple: there are tons of pictures, and you have to find the right ones.

Match all the books with the same little monsters on the covers — once you've paired them all, the level is complete! With over 100 levels, meditative gameplay, various cute monsters, and beautiful graphics. Play and relax!

title: Sort Water Now
description: A fascinating puzzle journey, a mysterious water sorting adventure, waiting for your experience!Rich and fascinating levels and a variety of props combination, let the classic puzzle game take on a new look!

title: Happy Color
description: Happy Coloring Pages is a free online coloring game for kids to play in the browser with no download. Relax, color, and get creative with fun templates—animals, cars, and more. Perfect for students searching “coloring pages for kids,” “kids coloring games,” or “cool math game” style freebie fun. This educational and creative HTML5 coloring book is easy to use on any device. Play now for a joyful, free, and colorful adventure anytime, anywhere!

title: iTileZen sort puzzle
description: iTileZen Sort Puzzle  is a fresh and addictive puzzle game that blends the strategic color sorting mechanics with the satisfying tile-matching gameplay. Moves  colorful tiles to complete objectives before time runs out! Whether you love logic puzzles or fast-paced matching challenges, this game offers the best of both worlds.

title: Live Star Doll Dress Up
description: Discover the makeover world of fashion and fun in Live Star Doll Dress Up Games! Immerse yourself in an interactive magic princess universe! In this dress-up anime simulator, you're in charge. Dress up your doll in trendy outfits. Get creative with makeup and personalize your cute doll!

title: Fashion Heroes Academy
description: Welcome to the Academy of Fashion Heroines, a place where style and superpowers go hand in hand! Three brave girls entered the academy in order not only to reveal their abilities, but also to create their own unique image. And you will help them in this. Choose outfits for studying, training and super battles. Experiment with makeup and accessories. Let each schoolgirl become a superhero and a style icon at the same time!

title: Dazzling Divas Makeup
description: Test your makeup artist skills in Dazzling Divas Makeup! Inspired by My Little Pony, this colorful dress-up game lets you create magical makeup looks for three fabulous girls—Lila, Mimi, and Roxy. Style each diva with Fluttershy, Pinkie Pie, and Rainbow Dash–inspired makeup, then complete their look with trendy tops and accessories. With endless outfit combos and sparkling vibes, this is the ultimate glam experience for fashion lovers!

title: Hexa Sort Trick or Treat
description: Step into a haunted puzzle realm where glowing hexagonal blocks hide within a web of spooky challenges. Your task: sort eerie, color-coded pieces into their rightful places before the shadows close in. With every drag and drop, you’ll sharpen your wits and unravel chillingly clever layouts that grow trickier as you progress. Easy to pick up yet devilishly addictive, this Halloween brain-teaser will keep players of all ages spellbound through hundreds of spooky levels.

title: Back To School: Uniforms Edition
description: Explore global fashion in Back to School: Uniforms Edition! This fun dress-up game lets you spin the wheel to unlock school uniforms from countries like Japan, the U.S., the U.K., India, France, and South Korea. Customize your character with stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles inspired by each culture. Dive into the diversity of school uniforms and become a fashion expert while having fun!

title: Magic Piano Music
description: Ready to become a piano master? In Magic Piano Music, tap the magic tiles to follow the beats and play your favorite music. Follow the rhythm of the music and click with precision, don't miss any notes. The game will end after three misses. There's tons of music here like classic piano music, pop music and more! Every song will take you on an immersive arcade rhythm adventure.

title: Block Escape
description: Block Escape is a brain-teasing puzzle game where players clear blocks by moving them off the screen in the direction shown by the arrows on each block. Each level requires logical thinking and careful planning, as blocks can only move in specific directions, making every puzzle increasingly challenging and strategic.

title: Cat Mini Restaurant
description: In this heartwarming and healing simulation management game "Meow Flavor Restaurant", you will become a little cat owner who loves cooking and personally create your own dream restaurant. Starting from a small cat house kitchen, gradually upgrading equipment, developing new recipes, recruiting cute cat employees, until becoming the most popular internet celebrity restaurant in the city! More than 30 cats with different personalities and skills are waiting for you to collect!

title: Crazy Tunnel
description: Crazy Tunnel is a fast-paced, first-person arcade game. Navigate through the tunnel at breakneck speeds and aim for the longest distance possible.

title: Around Elbrus
description: In the game “Around Elbrus”, the player controls a character who rushes down Mount Elbrus. The goal of the game is to collect all the coins and overcome various obstacles such as rocks, cliffs and avalanches. The game features beautiful graphics and addictive gameplay and is suitable for players of all ages.

title: Girlfriend from Hell
description:
Girlfriend From Hell is an addictive and fun 2D arcade puzzle game. The main goal of the game is the girl's revenge on her lover. The heroine needs to find objects and use them to make her boyfriend's life hell.  
You need to collect various items to make a trap with them.

title: Authentic Football
description:
3D modeling technology is employed to construct a lifelike football field, encompassing elements such as the green pitch, goalposts, and stands, thereby creating an immersive match atmosphere.
The player and football models also boast a high level of intricacy. The players' movements are smooth and natural, and the flight path of the football adheres to the laws of physics, enabling players to feel as if they are in a real - life football match.

title: Stickman Rocket
description: You have a powerful cannon loaded with Stickman Ragdols which you must shoot far to reach your target! Solve all kinds of challenges as you collect gems, avoid obstacles and control your throws to reach the targets in each level. Try not to bump into obstacles along the way and use all the raggedy characters you need to have fun with these amazing challenges - good luck!

title: Idle Firefighter 3D
description: Idle Firefighter 3D is a single player firefighter simulator game. You will play the role of a firefighter and it is your duty to save the survivors from the fire. Here, new emergencies are constantly occurring and you need to be on standby and must put out the fires as soon as possible! The fire extinguisher is your friend, if the props run out, you will not be able to put out the fire.

title: ASMR Washing & Fixing
description: This game is one of the cleaning games that gives you a real experience like no other. Most of the cleaning and organizing games on the market are 2D, but this game brings you a 3D experience. At the beginning of the game, you can pick a cool tool. There are 5 levels in this game and you can pick a level to start your cleaning. You can move your position as well as use the cleaning tool by clicking on the buttons on the screen or by hitting the keyboard.

title: Griddlers Deluxe
description: Welcome to Griddlers Deluxe! Immerse yourself in a world of captivating puzzles. Uncover hidden images by deciphering numerical clues on the grid. With almost 200 challenges, Griddlers Deluxe offers addictive brain-teasing fun. Ready to decode the mysteries? Play now!

title: Going Balls Adventure 2
description: Going Balls Adventure 2 is a ball-rolling arcade game with a 3D game engine. Your main mission is to collect black balls and reach the checkpoint. Your side mission is to collect all coins on the platform. It doesn't matter if you don't fish the job. Before the level begins, you have a chance to try some free skins for you to decide on a favorite one.

title: Single Stroke: Energy Line Puzzle
description: Single Stroke: Energy Line Puzzle is a fun and simple way to train your brain every day. This mind-challenging game has easy rules—just connect all the circles using a single continuous line. It’s a great way to keep your brain sharp with quick, clever puzzles. Spend just a few minutes daily to give your mind a boost. Enjoy this brain-training experience anytime, anywhere!

title: Hidden Horrors
description: Ready to explore the haunted Halloween world? Play a hidden object game with 30 Halloween levels. Each level has 6 hidden objects. Find all objects before time runs out. If you need help, use a hint. The game is easy to play. Enjoy colorful Halloween scenes and fun gameplay.

title: Merge cubes 2048 3D
description: A completely new approach to the classic game 2048?! Now in 3D and with dynamic physics?! Number cubes don't just merge - they bounce and collide?, adding an element of surprise to every game! Compete with friends or colleagues?!

title: Bus Jam
description: Welcome to the thrilling world of "Bus Jam: Clear the Bus Stop," presented by Golden Guns Studio, a color sort puzzle, fun-packed game where your task is to skillfully bus match 3d passengers onboard onto buses of the same color. Imagine a busy Bus Jam stop with vibrant buses and puzzled passengers eager to board. Your mission? Ensure each person finds their way to the right bus, and brace yourself as the color puzzle master.

title: Quest by Country
description: Quest by Country - an engaging game that allows players to identify countries by their flags. This captivating task serves as an educational tool, expanding players' knowledge of the diversity of countries and the symbolism conveyed through their flags.

title: Butterfly Kyodai Rainbow
description: Play Butterfly Kyodai Rainbow – a relaxing and colorful butterfly-matching puzzle game with fresh mechanics and vibrant rainbow visuals! Enjoy hundreds of exciting levels, earn daily rewards, take part in special events, and unlock beautiful new wings. A fun Mahjong-style connect game for all ages – no download required!

title: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense
description: Zombies have taken over the world! Unlock bases and deploy soldiers with unique weapons, each with stats like damage, fire rate, and reload speed. Soldiers must reload at the base before defending. Place them wisely to stop zombies within range. Defeat waves to earn coins, upgrade bases, and survive stronger hordes. Strategically choose soldiers to clear waves and save cities across the globe.

title: Space.io
description: Jump into the cockpit of a powerful spaceship and engage in fast-paced 3D space battles! Face off against 9 other enemy ships in an intense dogfight where only the best pilot survives. Shoot down your opponents before they take you out, climb the rankings, and prove you're the ultimate space warrior! Unlock a wide variety of skins to customize your ship and dominate the battlefield in style. Can you claim the top spot?

title: Slope Snowball
description: Slope SnowBall is an intriguing endless-running game with a winter theme. Your aim is to roll a snowball as far as possible down slopes full of hazards!

title: Superheroes and the Wand
description: You will play as a Wand character who had a strange dream about a sorcerer. Soon, in reality, the sorcerer from Stickman dream appears in the city and begins to do evil. Wand, together with the Superheroes, decide to teach the sorcerer a lesson. But not everything is so easy to do. The following superheroes are waiting for you: Blushing, Green Man, Bobo, Cudgel, Bruise, Flyer, Captain Captain and others. Among the enemies will be the Wizard, Anrik, the Clown and others.

title: Monster Makeup 3D
description: Show off your makeup skills by helping monsters blend seamlessly into human society. Protect them by keeping their true identities hidden from angry mobs. Transform monsters to hide in plain sight, ensuring their survival. Customize their look by choosing skin color, changing eye lenses, adjusting their teeth, and adding the perfect wig to complete their human disguise. But be careful—make a mistake, and you might become the monster's next meal!

title: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle
description: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle is an irresistibly fun puzzle casual game that bursts with juicy visuals and addictive gameplay! A brilliant combination of puzzle and match mechanics. From the moment you start, you’ll be hooked on its satisfying matching mechanics and clever level design.

title: Farm Block Puzzle
description: This is the perfect game to satisfy your craving for a logical tetris-inspired game with a fresh spin on it. The countryside aesthetic will capture your attention with its beautiful graphics and lovely music.

title: Word search
description:
A beautiful word puzzle game with challenging yet addictive features for hunting down the words you love! Train your brain in a fun and relaxing way and take your critical thinking skills and IQ to the next level.
Find all the words on a given topic. Words are arranged horizontally, vertically, diagonally, and may overlap.

title: Champions FC
description: Champions FC is a fast-paced, bite-size soccer match where you dribble, pass, and time your kicks to break through defenders and score. Play two quick halves, react to turnovers, and keep the ball in bounds. Nail the perfect moment, hear the whistle, and become Champion.

title: What's In My Bag?
description: Unpack style and surprises in What’s In My Bag? – the ultimate dress-up and makeup game for fashion lovers! Choose cute outfits, glam makeup, and trendy bags, then reveal what’s inside each one. From influencer props to girly goodies, every bag tells a story. Get creative, show off your style, and join the viral “what’s in my bag” trend now! Perfect for fans of dress-up games, makeup fun, and aesthetic vibes.

title: Brainrot Hole
description: Brainrot Hole is a fun casual game where you control a hole that sucks in objects. Your task is to guide the hole to eat all the objects and defeat all the Brainrot Enemies . As you progress through the levels,  the game gets more challenging with more complex obstacles to avoid. Use your strategy and quick reflexes to become the ultimate Brainrot Hole master!

title: Dig out of Prison
description:
You are a prisoner determined to break free. Dig tunnels with a spoon, shovel, or anything you can find. Discover valuables, trade with fellow inmates and even the guards, and earn the prison’s top currency — toilet paper.

Upgrade your digging and trading skills, unlock better tools, and speed up your escape. But be careful — plan your moves and avoid drawing attention, because freedom is the prize only for the most cunning.

title: Plant Merge: Zombie War
description: In the chaotic world of Merge Plant Zombie War, arm your garden with strategic merges to fend off relentless zombie hordes! Master upgrades, deploy special abilities, and outsmart waves of undead foes in this addictive merge-tower defense adventure. Will your botanical army prevail in the ultimate war for survival? Dive in and merge your way to victory!

title: Elemental Monsters: Merge & Evolution
description: Welcome to the world of "Elemental Monsters: Merge & Evolution"! This free online game is perfect for children and teenagers. Develop your logic and strategic thinking while taking part in epic battles with monsters. You will control an army of fire, water, earth and air elementals in an exciting battle to liberate their worlds.

title: Flower Sort
description:
Sort Flowers is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you sort flowers by type!
Combine three identical flowers in one pot to grow a lush, beautiful bush.
Plan your moves, create satisfying merge chains, and enjoy the colorful and cozy atmosphere.
Each level brings new combinations, vibrant colors, and delightful visual effects.

title: Escape from the Portal
description:
"Your soul is trapped between worlds. The only way home is to activate an ancient portal... but only one can pass through."
Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld.

title: Nuts Bolts Screw Glass
description: "Nuts & Bolts: Screw Glass" is a creative puzzle game. In this meticulously designed mechanical world, you need to match different screws to their corresponding colored boxes. Every move requires careful consideration, as unmatched screws will fall into the groove at the bottom — once the groove is filled, the game is over.

title: Connect Puzzle Image
description: Step into the delightful world of Connect Puzzle Image, a game designed to tease your brain and sharpen your observation skills. Match and connect a variety of funny characters, tasty foods, and interesting objects as you progress through colorful levels. Easy to play yet delightfully challenging, this free online puzzle game offers hours of relaxing entertainment on both mobile and desktop devices.

title: Tank Sniper 3D
description:
Tank Sniper 3D: The Ultimate Shooting Game
Are you a fan of shooting games? Do you have what it takes to be a sniper tank driver? Then youll love Tank Sniper 3D - the action game that puts your skills to the test. Shoot your enemies with one shot from behind cover. Stay hidden until you strike with a surprise shot. Then, dodge their fire and hit as many targets as you can. How long can you survive? Find out now and play Tank Sniper 3D!

title: Climb Up!
description: In this challenging adventure, you'll embark on a perilous ascent up a massive, treacherous mountain. Navigate slippery surfaces and unpredictable obstacles as you make your way towards the summit, where eternal glory and a rewarding gift await. Will you be able to overcome the many hurdles and reach the top, or will the climb prove too daunting? Your determination and skill will be tested as you brave the unknowns of this grueling climb.

title: Picture Puzzles
description: the picture puzzles includes dozens of different puzzles. you can increase or decrease the number of pieces of these puzzles as you wish. so you can make it suitable for all ages. you can have a pleasant time by having fun and exercising your brain. come on we are waiting for you.

title: The Trendy Mermaid
description: Embark on an exciting journey of makeup, accessories, and fashion to help Ariel make an unforgettable comeback. With a wide selection of clothes, makeup, and accessories, help Ariel become the trendiest mermaid ever. Enjoy making her look dreamy and fabulous - The Trendy Mermaid is free to play for every girl.

title: Block Mine Fuse TNT
description: Free the world from Herobrine and its creepy buildings. Upgrade and drop TNT, rockets and all your power on cubic settlements.

title: Gloves Grow Rush
description: “Gloves Grow Rush” is a 3D arcade game where you control stickman boxers in a vertical running challenge. Collect boxing gloves, battle weaker opponents, and take on the final boss at each level. If you encounter a stronger boxer, evade rather than fight to survive. Beware: a direct punch means game over! Claim gems to upgrade your starting level and attack power (ATK). The shop offers 6 unique boxing gloves, but they don’t grant extra ATK or levels. Best of luck!

title: Headless Joe
description: While playing, robot Joe literally lost his head. But it's not as hopeless as it seems. To get it back in place and screw it tightly, Joe needs to solve puzzles and collect all the bolts. But he can’t do this without your help!

title: Demolition Derby Derby
description: Welcome to Demolition Derby the mobile sensation where you control the chaos! Strategically tap to toss dynamite and swipe to send rocks crashing down. Decimate buildings and statues with precision in this hyper-casual game.

title: Basket Sport Stars
description: A great basket challenge begins with random characters and with random basketball arenas with the Basket Sport Stars game! Play single or 2 player! The game consists of many levels, characters, and various game modes like Tournament, Quick Matches, 2 player Matches, and Practice Matches. You can play any of these modes for free, without unlocking. Pick most of the characters for free and start shooting your opponent's basket hoop!

title: Doors Awakening
description: This is a challenging puzzle-solving online game.  This game has wonderful 3D graphics enabling you to explore the handcrafted levels. The fascinating visual effects, realistic atmosphere, and natural camera controls will keep you returning for more. If you'd prefer puzzle games, don't miss this wonderful challenge.

title: Ninja dash Cozy tactic puzzle
description:
Get ready to immerse yourself in a tactical puzzle adventure where you'll feel like a stealthy ninja and master strategist! Your mission: clear locations of enemies with a limited number of attacks. Plan your moves carefully and use the environment to your advantage by bouncing off walls and objects to change your trajectory.
Plan your tactics, execute perfect maneuvers, and become the ultimate ninja strategist!

title: Candy Rain 5
description: Get ready for a delightful and vibrant match-3 experience with Candy Rain 5! The beloved Candy Rain series continues with even more sugary fun and challenging puzzles to enjoy.

title: Rummy 500 Card Game
description:
Features :
- Offline game.
- 3 Super Modes: classic mode, 3 player mode and Speed mode.
- Auto arrange the cards
- Game statistics.
- Easy to play 
- Excellent and fair ai to play with.
- Continue the last game from where you left.
- No login required

title: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin
description:
You will be immersed in the dangerous world of ninja art, where every movement, every breath are decisive moments in your mission.

Your goal is to approach your enemies unnoticed, and to achieve this, you will have to skillfully use your blade to cut through the bamboo thickets, making your way through the dense forest.

But be on your guard, your enemies are not slumbering, and you can be detected at any moment.

title: Lost Adventure
description: Lost Adventure is a survival puzzle game where you guide a determined pilot through a strange, untamed land after a mid-air crash. Craft tools, mine resources, and solve clever challenges as you race to rescue scattered passengers. Your choices shape their fate—will you lead them to safety before the wilderness claims them for good?

title: Garten Of BanBan 1 Escape
description:
Enter Banban's Kindergarten, and you're sure to make some friends. Explore the mysterious establishment and don't lose your life and sanity. Uncover the horrifying truth behind the place, but be careful, as you are far from alone…

The Banban And Friends Gang:
Banban’s Kindergarten has earned a special place in every kid’s heart. The reason for this is the Banban And Friends Gang, which are the establishment’s mascots and icons. At Banban’s Kindergarten, nobody’s lonely thanks to them!

title: Merge Haven
description: Merge items to restore the café to its former glory, uncover hidden secrets, and discover its mysterious past. Start merging today to reveal the café's enchanting story!

title: Popping Pets
description: In Popping Pets, stack and match adorable pets to score points! Connect three or more adjacent pets to clear them before time runs out. Look out for bombs for big clears and big points. Can you reach the highest score in one minute?

title: GT Formula Championship
description: GT Formula Championship is an exhilarating high-speed racing game that brings the thrill of Formula racing to life. Step into the driver’s seat of the most powerful and technologically advanced Formula cars as you compete against elite racers on world-class tracks. With intense competition, realistic physics, and breathtaking visuals, this game delivers an adrenaline-fueled experience like no other.

title: Slope Emoji 2
description: Slope Emoji is a fantastic endless ball rolling game with many emoji balls. Guide a colorful cast of emoji characters down challenging slopes. Test your reflexes with endless series of obstacles, unexpected twists, and surprises. Collect Likes button for more new emoji characters with unique faces! Get ready for the ride of your life and master the art of ball rolling!

title: Little Hero Knight
description: In Little Hero Knight, you'll play the role of a brave little hero. Travel through a world full of monsters and keep fighting with your weapon. Build your defense towers and engage in a battle of wits and courage! Strategically manage your battlegrounds, build walls, barracks, houses and more! Build your base and towers using collected coins. Unlock powerful weapons and defense towers, and customize your battle setup!

title: Murderers VS Sheriffs Duels
description:
Love Roblox-style action games? Get ready for the ultimate showdown!

Jump into fast-paced 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 duels where every second counts. Play as a Murderer or a Sheriff, master unique abilities, and outplay your enemies in style.

If you enjoy games like Murder Mystery or Arsenal in Roblox, this is made for you!

title: Horror Minecraft Partytime
description: Horror Minecraft Partytime is a spooky and interesting horror survival game. This time you will enter a familiar world of blocks. In this hide-and-seek mode, you will be the pursuer, looking for every corner. Find the weirdo in disguise and catch him.

title: DON'T PANIC DUDE!
description:
Meet DUDE, a sassy AI who thinks you can't beat his game! Trapped in his chaotic simulation, your goal is simple: Jump, avoid deadly spikes, and survive to prove him wrong.

Features:

Fast-paced endless jumping action.

Unlock 40 unique and funny heroes.

Hilarious AI commentary and memes.

Increasing speed and difficulty.

Can you handle the chaos? Don't panic, just jump!

title: Bubiloons
description: Funny, witty, bubbling and very magical… these are the Bubiloons, some cute unicorn animals full of surprises that you will discover in this App.

title: Ultimate Plants TD
description: Ultimate Plants TD is an army of plants to protect your garden from countless zombies. Your goal is to protect your garden from challenging waves of zombies. Experimenting with different plant combinations and positioning is the key to maximizing your defense capabilities and overcoming tough challenges!

title: City Drift Racing
description: "City Drift Racing" is an atmospheric racing arcade game where crazy competitions await you on the streets of the metropolis.

title: City Tower Builder
description: In the game, you need to develop your own city, build houses, and place them around the city. You need to build the houses evenly so that the blocks don't fall to the ground. The game is a combination of a city-building simulator and an exciting arcade game where you need to build even houses out of blocks so that the blocks don't fall and the houses don't collapse.

title: Coffee Match Rush: Sort Puzzle
description: Get ready for a deliciously challenging in block puzzle game - Coffee Match: Block Puzzle. In this game, you’ll be tasked with block jam 3d puzzle - sorting coffee cups into the right trays. Each level presents a new set of challenges where you’ll need to move the coffee trays around and strategically place the cups before the timer runs out.

title: Children's doctor: treating ears
description: Ready to become the best pediatric doctor in the world? Learn to use medical instruments, give first aid to patients? Play our doctor without downloads, registration and absolutely free!

title: Match Ten Number Puzzle
description: Ready to put your brain to the test in a fun and relaxing way? Match Ten - Number Puzzle is a clever puzzle game that combines simple rules with surprisingly deep strategy. Once you start, you won’t want to stop! As levels progress, the board becomes more complex, and every number choice matters. Plan carefully, think ahead, and keep the board under control! If you enjoy number-based puzzle games, this one is a must-play!

title: Dragon Escape
description: The cute dinosaur wants to reach the exit by eating Sandwich in the area protected by robots. If you want to help him, try to pass the levels by using laser traps without entering the robots' field of vision.

title: Valentines Love Link
description: Valentines Love Link is a cute and relaxing matching puzzle game full of hearts, roses, chocolates, and love symbols. Connect matching Valentines items with straight lines, allowing up to two turns. Beat the clock across 48 levels by collecting all tiles and enjoy a sweet romantic theme.

title: Seat Jam 3D
description:
Seat Jam 3D is surely an entertaining puzzle game in which you place the passengers in the correct seats. You simply need to click on the passenger and then click on the correct seat. The first few
levels are very simple, but before long, you'll have to think long and hard before you can put all the passengers in the right seats. Solve the bus rush. They can move
up and down, left and right, but not diagonally. Train your brain with engaging puzzles in Seat Jam 3D. Come and join the game!

title: Sky Balls 3D
description: Sky Balls 3D invites you on an adventure as you travel through the sky with rolling balls and test your reaction skills. Keep the ball on the track without letting it fall and watch out for obstacles, traps and gaps! Collect coins and keys along the way to get new ball skins and sky-boxes. You can play the game in 1 player and 2 player modes.

title: Helix Crush
description: "The gameplay is very simple and can be accomplished with only one finger, yet it will also bring you countless challenges and fun. You need to jump and fall through the helix tower, cutting through the colorful fruit and cake slices on the way. But be careful! There are many obstacles and traps along the way, and it will be up to your reflexes and luck to get through them.

title: Reflect Beam: Laser Logic
description:
Logic game where every move changes the beam’s path. 

5 modes - 5 types of challenges.
Tunnel: rotate shapes and guide the beam through narrow passages.
Labyrinth: draw a safe path to the exit.
Same Colors: remove blocks of the right color to open the route.
Obstacles: move elements and clear the way for the beam.
Time is limeted: solve faster and more accurately before time runs out.

title: Reach 2048
description: The classic 2048 puzzle — slide numbered tiles on a grid, merge them, and reach the legendary 2048 tile! Simple to learn, impossible to put down. Challenge your brain with this addictive number puzzle. Plan your moves carefully, build combos, and aim for the highest score. How far can you go beyond 2048?

title: Gemstone Glam
description: Welcome to the fabulous world filled with sparkling gems! Here you will meet two princess girlfriends who adore fashionable outfits and the glitter of colorful stones in fashionable outfits. Try on dresses inspired by the radiance of a diamond, the passion of a ruby, the freshness of an emerald and the mystery of an amethyst. Create shining combinations of hairstyles, dresses and accessories to transform young princesses into real fashion queens. Feel like a real stylist of the jewelry kingdom!

title: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game
description: Dive deep into the vibrant and enthralling world of fruit-matching with our exciting game, Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game! When the same fruits collide, they merge into a larger fruit. Your mission is to smartly pair the same types of fruits to make the biggest possible fruits without letting them overflow from the container. However, as the fruits grow in size, space becomes a premium - managing it effectively is your key challenge. Can you strategize and solve this fruity puzzle?

title: Wednesday Light Academia
description: Join the trend in Wednesday Light Academia - a fun, immersive makeover game for girls! Today you're becoming a super-talented stylist and your job is to transform Wednesday Addams from a dark e-girl look to a stunning girly-girl fashionista. Explore the fun realms of makeup, hairstyling, and fashion-forward wardrobe choices with this addictive game. Have fun!

title: Hide Ball
description: Hide Ball is an addictive puzzle game where your mission is to protect the red ball from dangerous spiky enemies. Use the given blocks to build a safe shelter and hide the ball. Each level brings a new challenge — the constructions become trickier, and the enemies more relentless. Plan your moves, create a solid defense, and save your little hero!

title: Urban Assault Force
description: Step into the boots of an elite counter-terrorism unit in Urban Assault Force, an intense first-person shooter that plunges you into the heart of urban warfare. The city is under siege by a ruthless terrorist group, and it's up to you and your team to strike back and save the day.

title: Zombie Idle Defense
description: Prepare for a zombie showdown in Zombie Idle Defense! In this exciting idle defense game, you will be the last line of defense against wave after wave of zombie attacks! Build your defenses,upgrade your weapons, put your automatic turrets on fire, and fight off the undead!

title: Soda Block Jam
description:
Slide soda crates, collect bottles, and deliver to the right
exits. A smooth, colorful puzzler that blends motion and
color-matching

title: Tropical Match
description: Embark on a vibrant adventure in Tropical Match 3! Help Coco, your lively island guide, find fruits and other island gems in a tropical paradise. Match exotic fruits, uncover vibrant flowers and observe colourful exotic birds while enjoying the island adventure. The game features exciting levels and a relaxing island soundtrack! So what are you waiting for? Enjoy the tropical paradise adventure now!

title: The Walking Deadblocks
description: A fast-paced, cooperative survival game where players battle relentless waves of zombies across dynamic day-night cycles. Survive as long as possible by managing resources, unlocking new maps, and utilizing unique character abilities. Nights bring increased danger with randomized enemy spawns, challenging players to strategize using generators and lights to stay alive.

title: Ludo Star
description: Enter the arena of strategy and chance! Choose your favorite mode, unlock stylish dice skins and climb the trophy road. Outsmart opponents, master your moves and prove you’ve got what it takes to rule the board and become a Ludo Star.

title: Nuts Stack Sort: Nuts & Bolts
description:
Challenging yet relaxing Nuts & Bolts sort puzzle with a unique twist!

Nuts Stack Sort: Nuts & Bolts is a fun and addictive stack sort puzzle game with a unique twist! Strategically sort and match three same color nuts based on box color in this jam puzzles. Every level offers an exciting challenge in this addictive sort colors puzzle game. Test yourself with this amazing brain teaser!

title: Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Step into the shadows with Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks! Explore abandoned castles, fend off lurking vampires, and rebuild forgotten halls. Play 200+ haunting Solitaire levels plus 50 chilling Mahjong boards. Face spooky twists like frozen and locked cards, tricky obstacles, and powerful boosts. Search the dark, cobwebby corners of every last level for gems and coins to purchase new castle upgrades and power-ups. Are you ready for a Solitaire adventure that sends shivers down your spine?

title: Ball Bunker: Sneaky Stacks
description: Ball Bunker: Sneaky Stacks is a fun physics puzzle where your goal is to keep the ball safe! Tap to drop shapes and stack them into a bunker. Rotate pieces to fill gaps, then release the enemy balls. If your bunker holds, you win — if the ball gets hit, you fail. Simple, clever, and addictive!

title: Theo Morini's Magical Resort
description:
“Theo Morini’s Magical Resort” is a magical, romantic, and captivating merge puzzle game about rebuilding a resort on an enchanted island.

Talented writers and actors created this story and brought its characters to life. Enjoy the story!

title: Flip It 3D
description: In this fun and challenging puzzle platform game, test your strategic thinking as you navigate through levels where flipping platforms is the key to survival! Goblins and knights have different abilities, and they must be moved carefully across platforms to complete each level. But be careful—characters can only survive a limited number of flips, and platforms can't be flipped if they are occupied!

title: Dessert DIY
description: Step into a sweet little food studio and craft desserts for hungry customers! Follow simple step-by-step recipes, pick the right ingredients, and assemble tasty treats exactly as requested. Satisfy each guest to earn coins, then spend your rewards in the shop to unlock more items, upgrades, and delicious options. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and full of colorful desserts!

title: Hoop World 3D
description: Hoop World 3D is a flip-and-dunk game that brings basketball to a whole new dimension! Get your timing right or you'll fall short of the net and fall flat on your face.

title: Puzzle Lab
description: Tap connected blocks to clear them! If any blocks are left, you will lose life. The game ends when your life reaches 0. You can use placed special bombs by tapping them.

title: Swipetown
description: Swipe to combine tiles and build your own fantasy town in this addictive 2048 puzzler! Merge buildings into new ones and create your own village paradise. When the board fills up, you’re done!

title: Star Wing
description: Earth's last hope is in your hands, take control of the lone spaceship and protect Earth from alien swarms. Your goal will be quite challenging as you will have to save the Universe from its evil enemies. In this space shooting game, you will be facing an increasingly large number of enemies in hazardous environments. As the game progresses, you will earn the right to upgrade your spacecraft to unleash its full lethal capacity.

title: Quizmania: Trivia game
description: Sharpen your mind across exciting levels. Answer a variety of questions from different topics and use strategic hints to guide your way. As you progress, the difficulty increases, offering a rewarding and challenging experience with every round.

title: Darts Master:Cartoon 3D
description: Dear dart experts and those who want to become dart experts. Please showcase your talents to the fullest on this thrilling dart journey. Collect and enrich your dart warehouse with the goal of overcoming all challenges. Experience the joy of different dart competitions.

title: Block Master - Super Puzzle
description: Welcome to a unique puzzle game where logic and strategy decide everything! Experience a fresh take on classic block games! The pieces appear at the bottom, and it’s up to you to decide where to place them. Drag the blocks onto the field, fill horizontal and vertical lines, and clear space for new moves. Every action requires careful planning—can you score the highest points?

title: Last Stand Warrior
description:
A thrilling third-person shooter where you play as an experienced shooter defending your land from endless hordes of enemies. Control the hero, apply precise punches, use skills and fight with waves of mobs to prevent them from breaking through. Upgrade your weapons and abilities to become a true defense champion!

Ideal for fans of dynamic gameplay, arcade battles and survival in the «wave of opponents» mode.

title: angry snake io
description: Angry Snake io " is an exciting and addictive arcade game where you take control of a fierce, hungry snake on a mission to grow, survive, and dominate the arena! Slither through a vibrant world, gobbling up colorful orbs to grow longer and stronger. But watch out—danger lurks around every corner! Avoid obstacles, outsmart traps, and navigate increasingly challenging levels as your snake grows bigger and faster.

title: Treasure Champion - Chest Capture
description: Dive into the exciting world of stickmen in this exciting team game! Your task is to capture the chest in the center of the field and deliver it to the base together with your team, avoiding traps and tricky moves of your opponents. Each successfully delivered chest brings points, and the dynamics of the game keep you in suspense until the last second.

title: Brainrot Cleaning
description: Welcome to Brainrot Cleaning, the weirdly satisfying cleaning simulation that turns chaos into calm. In this fun and quirky casual game, your job is to scrub away the mess caused by the wild world of brainrot characters and their hilarious antics! In the Cleaning Italian Brainrot or the Underwater mode, you will finish various cleaning tasks.

title: Roblo X Zombie
description: Get ready for an intense solo survival experience in Zombie Defense Builder! As the last survivor, you must gather supplies, scavenge for collectibles, and build strong defenses to hold off waves of relentless zombies. In this action-packed, strategic game, every second counts. Gather materials, craft powerful barricades, and upgrade your defenses before the next wave hits. Can you survive the apocalypse and fend off the undead for as long as possible

title: Chocolate Dream: Idle Factory
description: Play Chocolate Dream: Idle Factory free online and build your candy empire in a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Produce chocolate bars, upgrade machines, and expand smart production lines in a strategy experience that feels like a rewarding brain game. This unblocked game runs smoothly at school or home and is fully mobile-friendly. Optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game perfect for quick breaks or long, satisfying factory.

title: FreeCell
description: Unlike other card games that rely on luck, almost every game of FreeCell is solvable—if you have the skill. Use the four open "free cells" as temporary holders to juggle your cards and organize the chaotic tableau. Plan your moves carefully, stack cards by alternating colors, and clear the board. Whether you want a relaxing break or a serious brain workout, this is the perfect puzzle for you.

title: Deadlock.io
description: Deadlock.io is an exciting game in the deadlock setting, where you capture territories and avoid enemies. Compete for the territory in thrilling battles! Become the leader of the arena like in paper.io!

title: Sportsball Merge
description:
Stretch, pull, and jump! Lets workout and be active in Sports Merge.

Drop the orbs filled with energy to discover new and exciting forms of exercise. Merge them all but be careful how high you jump!

What is the highest score you can reach? Come play now and lets find out!

title: Mathematics Racing
description: Welcome to Mathematics Racing, the thrilling game where your math skills determine your speed on the track! Dive into a world where solving math problems propels you to victory. Here's what you need to know.

title: Shipbuilding tycoon
description:
Do you want to become a shipyard manager and build big ships?
Step into the role of a shipyard manager and grow your very own ship empire in this addictive idle game! As you build ships, earn profits, and unlock epic vessels, you’ll expand your factory and boost production efficiency.

title: Sweet Haunt 2
description: Guide the ghost to pick up all of the candy and get it to the exit in this Sokoban-like puzzle game. 50 challenging levels to complete. You'll need to pick up candy carefully as depending on how they are carried, the ghost and the candy might not fit into the pathway to the exit. Use bombs strategically to destroy objects the ghost is carrying to be sure you can make it to the exit and not get stuck.

title: Off Road Overdrive
description: Off Road Overdrive plays like a side-scrolling car-balanced game with 2D cartoon vehicles. Let me introduce the game modes for you!If you want to make a perfect record, play Challenge mode with different terrains again and again including Snow, Beachwear, Field, Desert, and Dark Night. Even the 2D platform will test your driving skills and balance abilities!

title: Unblock Ball Slide Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Unblock Ball: Slide Puzzle, a classic sliding puzzle game that lets you use your mind.You can feel a sense of accomplishment! Sliding the board to create the channel for the ball to roll smoothly to the end. You should use your logical mind to cleverly move blocks, avoid
obstacles, and solve every puzzle!

title: Perfect Cake Maker
description: Get ready to make some seriously delicious cakes in Perfect Cake Maker! It’s a delightful casual simulation game. When you start, you’ll see a fully stocked kitchen and delicious guests waiting. First, choose the cake base based on your guests’ needs. Then comes the fun part – mixing the ingredients!

title: Barbee Summer Vacation
description: Summer’s here, and it’s time for Barbee and her besties to enjoy their dream vacation! In Barbee Summer Vacation, you’ll help each character get ready with stylish warm-weather outfits, fun accessories, and fresh summer vibes. Whether it’s flowy dresses, sunglasses, or floral tops, it’s all about picking looks that scream sunshine.

title: Scroll and Spot
description: Experience the joy of the holidays with Scroll and Spot, a unique Christmas-themed puzzle game! Explore two beautifully crafted images as you scroll to uncover five subtle differences hidden within.The scrolling feature keeps both images perfectly aligned, making it a dynamic and immersive puzzle experience. Challenge your observation skills and celebrate the holiday spirit with every discovery!

title: Draw Climber
description:
Funniest race you ever played ! Draw your legs to win the race!
Any drawing will make you run !
When you are stuck you can draw another shape to pass!

title: Mini Games Relax Collection 2
description: Relax and take a mini-game tour! Mini Games: Relax Collection 2 brings you a series of casual and fun mini-games, designed for you to relax in your spare time! There are various types of games,each easy to play and extremely fun, allowing you to immerse yourself easily in the game world.

title: Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic
description: Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic is a casual simulation game where you act as a skillful mechanic. Your clients meet diverse problems with their cars: broken windows, cracked car doors, flat tires, malfunctioning motors, lack of car parts...

title: Mahjong Masters
description:
Enter the world of Mahjong Masters, where classic Mahjong meets fast-paced tile matching! 
In this exciting game, players have 2 minutes to match as many Mahjong tile pairs as possible. 
Each round is a thrilling battle against a new opponent. 
Accumulate battle points with each victory to climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate Mahjong Master.

title: Drawer Sort
description: Do you like a cluttered space exactly where everything has its place? It is time to organize your life and become a tidying hero, conquering chaos one drawer at a time.  Be sure to plan ahead for this epic puzzle or you may find yourself with a messier hand than when you started! Each brain training task will challenge you to place various items in the right places. You'll have to aim for perfect precision if you want to make sure the objects fit snugly and achieve the ultimate tidy victory.

title: Crazy Bike Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 2 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Crazy Bike Stunts PvP!

title: Mind Gambit
description: Mind Gambit is a relaxing puzzle game inspired by the classic Peg Solitaire. Plan your moves carefully to jump and remove pegs until only one remains. There’s no timer, just pure strategy and thoughtful gameplay. With unlimited levels, the challenge never ends.

title: Cool Girl Aesthetics
description: In Cool Girl Aesthetics, join Mia as she creates her ultimate trendy look! Start by customizing her Stanley cup with fun colors, prints, and accessories. Then, style her headphones, giving them a unique vibe. Next, design her manicure with cool colors, rings, and temporary tattoos for a stylish edge. Complete the look with makeup options like face stickers, colorful braces, and more. Dive into this fun, creative dress-up, and makeover game for endless aesthetic options.

title: Cargo Path Puzzle
description: Cargo Path Puzzle is a challenging 3D puzzle game that tests both logic and movement strategy. Navigate through complex levels filled with collapsing platforms, ice slides, trampolines, directional blocks, and deadly voids. Every level has only one correct path, so you'll need to think ahead and plan each move wisely. A single wrong step could trap you or block the way forward.

title: Snake Go - Escape Puzzle
description: Your goal is simple: guide the snake through tangled grids and help it escape without getting stuck. Each level challenges you to think ahead, choose the right order, and find safe paths through tight spaces. Blending classic snake mechanics with modern puzzle escape logic, every maze feels handcrafted — clean, clever, and satisfying to solve.

title: Iconic Halloween Costumes
description: Get ready for a spooky and stylish adventure in Iconic Halloween Costumes! Help three BFFs pick out their perfect Halloween looks, from royal Glinda and Bridgerton-inspired outfits to edgy Beetlejuice vibes and cowgirl-chic styles. Customize their costumes with tops, bottoms, accessories, and makeup to create iconic Halloween outfits. Play now and let the fashion fun begin!

title: Addiction Solitaire
description: A classic solitaire game using the full deck, featuring two difficulty modes: EASY and HARD. Enjoy polished animations and an intuitive card placement system that makes gameplay smooth and satisfying.

title: Pull The Pins
description: Pull the Pins is a strategic puzzle game where you must carefully pull pins in the correct order to rescue a young boy and make him reach his brother. Each decision matters, as a wrong move could lead to failure. Plan your actions wisely and use problem-solving skills to ensure a successful rescue.

title: GT Flying Car Racing
description: GT Flying Car Racing is an exhilarating game where players race high-speed GT cars that can transform into flying machines! Navigate through challenging tracks, perform daring aerial maneuvers, and switch seamlessly between driving and flying modes. Avoid obstacles, compete against rivals, and master both land and air racing to become the ultimate champion!

title: Paint Roller
description: Control two tethered spheres in this unique painting challenge. Click to anchor one sphere in place while the other swings around it on an elastic tether, leaving a dynamic paint trail. Your objective? Strategically rotate your tethered pair to completely coat all target cylinders in each level.

title: CraftsMan 3D Gangster
description:
In the new action game CraftsMan 3D Gangster, which is exciting and similar to Minecraft, you may become a real-life gangster roaming the streets of the city. As you explore the open world, you'll encounter other criminals who are eager to wipe you off the map.

Get through every level of this fun 3D action game, where you'll face more frightening adversaries.

title: Super Stock Stack
description: Super Stock Stack challenges you to sort food cans onto shelves with speed and clever organization! Match the cans by their labels, manage the growing stock, and test your skills as the levels get tougher. Can you become the ultimate stock master?

title: Driver Master Simulator
description: Driver Master Simulator is a 3D vehicle driving game. In Truck Mode, your task is to swiftly transport animals to their destinations. All transport missions have tight time constraints. Once you’ve earned $20,000, unlock Bus Mode and take the wheel of a bus. Reach $30,000, and Chopper Mode lets you pilot a helicopter. Feeling cash-strapped? Watch ads to claim $10,000 each time!

title: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
description: Step into the world of ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang, where you take on the role of an adorable mukbang streamer! Get ready to indulge in delicious food, satisfy your cravings, and share the experience with your viewers in a cozy, interactive livestream. The more you eat and engage, the more you earn!

title: Brawl Stars Brave Adventure
description: Brawl Stars Brave Adventure is a casual battle game designed for brave boys who love fast-paced action and nonstop adventure. Control fearless heroes as you battle enemies, avoid traps, and blast your way through nervous levels. Defeat monsters to constantly upgrade. Choose your skills to ensure your survival or increase your damage! Keep moving to avoid enemy attacks! Complete all levels to win. Get coins to unlock a variety of awesome weapons. Like darts, axes, etc.

title: Football Rush 3D
description: Football Rush 3d is a fast-paced, one-touch soccer game that puts you in the boots of a solo football hero. Forget complex controls—just tap, strike, and score! Whether you’re curving shots from midfield or charging down the pitch with speed boosts, every moment is packed with action.

title: Matrix Typer
description: Type like a hacker, train like a pro. Dodge incoming code, out-type digital attacks, and prove you can survive inside the system. Every word you type is a bullet dodged; every mistake, a strike you take.

title: TearDown - Destruction SandBox
description:
The player is given complete freedom of action. You can explore various locations filled with structures. The main feature of the game is the ability to destroy everything you see.

Have you ever wanted to level a multi-storey house with your own hands? Now you have the opportunity to do just that! The physics of destruction is close to reality. You can use a variety of weapons to destroy objects, from a hammer to a powerful bazooka.

title: Fill Glass
description:
Fill Glass is a simple yet addictive game. Fill the glass to the perfect level without letting it overflow or fall short of the target. Precision is key as you pour, aiming for the highest highscore!
As you progress, upgrade your pouring machine to enhance your accuracy!

title: Obby Rescue Mission
description: Obby rescue mission is a free online game, a set of missions and levels of this game will test your ability to aim and shoot in fast motion to eliminate all the targets in each level. Little Obby is on a rescue mission of citizens captured by a gang of gangsters in the city and your goal is to rescue and eliminate all these enemies that are in your way.

title: Build A Rich Queen
description: Make the most accurate choice and become the most beautiful queen! In Build A Rich Queen, you will bring your credit card. When you encounter a POS machine on the road, you can directly swipe the card to buy clothes and other decorations. These decorations will allow you to pass obstacles without directly failing the game, but you will lose these decorations. But pay attention to the road under your feet, don't fall suddenly, otherwise, you will directly fail the game.

title: Match Master
description:
Match them all!

And finally, it's time to dress up! Help us choose fashionable and elegant sports outfits to emphasize the fitness style of our heroine. Explore vibrant levels from forests to icy lands, unlock powerful abilities, trigger explosive chain reactions, and master increasingly challenging puzzles in this fun, casual browser game experience.

title: Domino World

title: Funny Fruits: Merge and Gather Watermelon

Are you ready to become the owner of the coolest pet collection? Merge them, upgrade buildings and open new islands!

title: Cute Craft Lab

If you love relaxing gameplay mixed with adorable creativity, this cute design adventure is made just for you. In Cute Craft Lab, enter a magical workshop filled with charming tools, sparkling decorations, and endless crafting possibilities.

title: StickMan Gunner
description: StickMan Gunner is a fast-paced running game that puts players in control of a powerful gun zipping through levels. You guide it to pick up stickmen along the way, building up your crew while smashing through obstacles and enemies that pop up. It’s straightforward gameplay that keeps things moving without much downtime, making it a solid pick for short sessions during study breaks or downtime.

title: Grass Ranch
description: Grass Ranch is a super fun and relaxing casual game that makes you a true ranch grass-mowing master. If you like to complete simple and fun tasks in a cozy environment, then you can't miss this game. In this world of green grass, you will mow grass constantly. title: Survival Island: EVO

Explore hidden corners of the island, discover secrets, and unlock new crafting recipes. Become the true survivor.

title: Number Rush
description:
You can absorb smaller or equal numbers while avoiding obstacles.
If you collide with a number bigger than you, it's game over.

description:
The main principle is pretty simple – you are controlling a small ball that is always moving forward.

On your way, there are a few obstacles that you need to get through. There’s a small problem however, because you can only touch obstacles that are the same color as your ball. If you touch an obstacle with a different color, the game ends and you need to start from the beginning.

description:
Ready to test your precision? Welcome to Axe Throw, the ultimate test of aim and timing. The rules are simple, but the challenge is endless. You have one goal: Break the target.

But be careful—the path to victory is rigged with danger. Explosive bombs are moving, and blocking your way. One wrong move, and it's game over!

title: Jigsolitaire
description: Step into a peaceful world of beautiful images made from gentle, carefully crafted blocks. Each level reveals a new scene - warm landscapes, charming cottages, delicate nature details, and quiet corners you’ll love exploring piece by piece.

title: World Cup 2026 Soccer Game
description:
Choose your national team and enter the excitement of the World Cup!

Defend your goal, watch for the perfect opening, and strike to score!

description:

title: Stack Battle.io
description:

Players who like brick-moving games come and download it.

title: Hexa Tap Away

Strategize to free the trapped fish on the beach, testing your problem-solving skills. With numerous levels that increase in difficulty, it's a great way to pass the time.

Each level presents a unique figure that you must finish without lifting your finger or mouse and without crossing the line twice.
The experience is calm, strategic, and rewarding — ideal for players who enjoy logic-based challenges.

Move cards between columns, use the free cells cleverly, and organize suits in ascending order to win.
